full_judgment: 2. Material facts of the case as necessary for disposal of the Rule are that the present opposite party Nos. 1-5 as plaintiffs, filed Title Suit No. 6 of 2000 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Balagonj, Sylhet for permanent injunction on the allegation that the first schedule land of the plaint is the inherited land and the same was recorded in the name of the predecessor of the plaintiffs in SA Khatian; that the BRS record of the suit land has been recorded in the name of the plaintiffs and the proforma defendants; that the nature of the land is dwelling house, pond and bank of the pond and the same is partly surrounded by pillars and boundary wall; that the land of 2nd schedule is within the 1st schedule having bamboo bush and other, trees as external part of the homestead of the plaintiffs and defendants; that plot Nos.627 and 628 are not the suit property and these are the dwelling houses of the defendant Nos. 1-4 and they have got their own pathway for ingress and outgress from their homestead; that the defendants in collusion with each other created some forged documents showing purchase of the northern portion of SS Plot No. 620 and demarcated the same by pucca wall from east to west and there is no pathway in the 2nd schedule land; that in the 3rd week of February, 2000 the defendants threatened to interfere with the peaceful possession of the plaintiffs in the suit 2nd schedule land within the 1st schedule by constructing a new pathway by force; hence the suit for permanent injunction against the defendants, for restraining them from in any way disturbing the peaceful possession of the plaintiffs in the suit land.
